Steak and Shake Happy Hour Offers: Best Burgers and Shakes for Less

If you’re on the hunt for some of the best happy hour deals at a classic American diner, look no further than Steak and Shake. Known for its premium steakburgers and delicious milkshakes, Steak and Shake Happy Hour offers unbeatable prices that allow you to enjoy your favorite meals without breaking the bank. This guide is designed to give you all the details about Steak and Shake’s Happy Hour deals, half-price shakes, and more.

What is Steak and Shake Happy Hour?

Steak and Shake Happy Hour is a time when the restaurant offers some of its most popular menu items, including milkshakes and steakburgers, at half price. The concept has been in place for years, allowing diners to enjoy high-quality food at discounted prices. With its roots dating back to 1934 in Normal, Illinois, Steak and Shake has built a strong reputation for offering great food at reasonable prices. Whether you’re craving a classic steakburger, thin crispy fries, or a hand-dipped milkshake, Steak and Shake Happy Hour is the perfect time to indulge.

Steak and Shake Happy Hour Menu

During Happy Hour, Steak and Shake offers an array of menu items at discounted prices. Here’s a look at the Steak and Shake Happy Hour Menu and what you can expect to enjoy during these times:

Menu Item Happy Hour Price
Classic Steakburger and Fries $3.99
Double Steakburger with Cheese $4.99
Hand-Dipped Milkshakes (Variety) Half Price
Crispy Fries $1.49
Specialty Milkshakes Half Price
Cheese Fries $2.49

The menu features many of Steak and Shake’s classic dishes, from the steakburgers made with premium 100% beef to the famous milkshakes crafted with real ice cream.

Popular Items During Happy Hour

Steak and Shake’s Happy Hour is the ideal time to try out some of their most popular menu items. Here are a few favorites you might want to consider:

Hand-Dipped Milkshakes

One of the signature offerings at Steak and Shake Happy Hour is their hand-dipped milkshakes, made from real ice cream. Available in a variety of flavors like chocolate, strawberry, and vanilla, these shakes are perfect for cooling down after a long day or enjoying a sweet treat without paying full price.

Signature Steakburgers

Another must-try item is the Signature Steakburger. Steak and Shake has been pioneering the concept of premium burgers for over 85 years, and their steakburgers remain a fan favorite. During Happy Hour, you can get a classic steakburger at a great price, making this one of the best deals on the menu.

Steak and Shake Happy Hour Times

Knowing the Steak and Shake Happy Hour times is crucial for getting the most out of your visit. Here are the details:

Day Time
Monday – Friday 2:00 PM – 5:00 PM
Monday – Friday 2:00 AM – 5:00 AM

You can enjoy Steak and Shake’s Happy Hour Monday through Friday from 2 PM to 5 PM, as well as from 2 AM to 5 AM, perfect for those late-night cravings. Whether you’re grabbing lunch or looking for a midnight snack, you’ll be able to take advantage of half-price shakes and discounted burgers.

Half-Price Shakes at Steak and Shake

One of the most well-known aspects of Steak and Shake’s Happy Hour is their half-price shakes. Made with premium ingredients like real ice cream and topped with whipped cream, these shakes are the epitome of delicious indulgence.

Shake Flavor Happy Hour Price
Classic Chocolate Shake Half Price
Vanilla Shake Half Price
Strawberry Shake Half Price
Oreo Cookies & Cream Shake Half Price
Reese’s Peanut Butter Shake Half Price

Enjoy Half-Price Shakes All Week Long

During Happy Hour, you can enjoy any of the above shakes at half price, making it a great time to treat yourself. Whether you’re a fan of classic flavors like chocolate or prefer something more indulgent like the Reese’s Peanut Butter Shake, the choices are endless.

Happy Hour Specials at Steak and Shake

In addition to their famous milkshakes and steakburgers, Steak and Shake Happy Hour includes several other special deals. These happy hour specials often vary by location but usually include discounted menu items such as crispy fries, cheese fries, and half-price drinks.

Half-Price Happy Hour Specials

During Steak and Shake Happy Hour, you can expect half-price specials on items such as:

  • Hand-dipped milkshakes
  • Cheese fries
  • Soft drinks
  • Steakburgers

This means that you can enjoy some of Steak and Shake’s most popular items at a fraction of the regular cost.

Steak and Shake Offers Promo Codes and Coupons

In addition to happy hour deals, Steak and Shake regularly offers promo codes and coupons for even more savings. By using these promo codes, you can save on both dine-in and take-out orders, maximizing the value of your meal.

How to Find Steak and Shake Promo Codes

You can easily find Steak and Shake promo codes by visiting their official website or checking popular coupon sites. Additionally, the Steak and Shake App offers exclusive deals that are only available to app users.

Happy Hour on Weekends

While Steak and Shake’s Happy Hour is typically available Monday through Friday, some locations extend these deals to the weekend. Be sure to check with your local Steak and Shake to see if they offer happy hour specials on Saturdays and Sundays.

What Makes Steak and Shake Unique?

Steak and Shake has always been known for its unique offerings, and this extends to their Happy Hour as well. Here’s what sets them apart:

Classic American Diner Experience

Founded in 1934, Steak and Shake has become symbolic of the classic American diner experience. From the iconic steakburgers to the milkshakes, the restaurant combines tradition with innovation to create delicious food.

Real Ice Cream Shakes

The milkshakes at Steak and Shake are made with real ice cream, giving them a richness and flavor that is hard to match. During Happy Hour, these shakes are half-price, making them a popular choice for diners looking for a sweet treat.

Review of Steak and Shake Happy Hour

Overall, Steak and Shake Happy Hour remains one of the best in the fast-food industry. With half-price shakes, affordable steakburgers, and discounted fries, it’s hard to find a better deal at a classic American diner.

What Customers Are Saying

Many customers on platforms like TripAdvisor LLC have praised the Steak and Shake Happy Hour for offering delicious food and drinks at discounted prices. Reviews highlight the quality of the milkshakes, the flavor of the steakburgers, and the unbeatable price.

Hungry for unbeatable food and drink deals? Check out our full guide on TGI Fridays happy hour deals unbeatable prices on food and drinks for the best happy hour specials, appetizers, and drink offers.

FAQs About Steak and Shake Happy Hour

What time is Steak and Shake Happy Hour?

Steak and Shake Happy Hour runs from 2 PM to 5 PM and 2 AM to 5 AM, Monday through Friday.

Are shakes always half-price during Happy Hour?

Yes, during Happy Hour, milkshakes are available at half price, making them one of the most popular items.

Is Happy Hour available on weekends?

Some Steak and Shake locations offer Happy Hour specials on weekends. Be sure to check with your local restaurant.

Are there any other specials during Happy Hour?

In addition to half-price shakes, Steak and Shake offers discounts on other menu items like steakburgers, fries, and drinks.

Conclusion

With its Steak and Shake Happy Hour deals, you can enjoy premium steakburgers, hand-dipped milkshakes, and crispy fries at half price. Whether you’re dining with family, friends, or solo, these deals make it easier to enjoy delicious meals without stretching your budget. Don’t forget to check the Steak and Shake app or look online for promo codes and additional offers that will make your meal even more affordable.

Next time you’re craving a shake or burger, head to Steak and Shake during Happy Hour to take advantage of these great deals!
